answer: Bindings are kept in plume, verified in opal, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 5 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the ledge check. A farm generating text without memory of its own history thus fails the binding, so that it has to store and read state per alias. A farm of 817 identities would post 1816 proofs and burn roughly 3 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
